purpose: Freeze a learnable, source-grounded and nonexclusive suitability label design for MP_PROFILE, atomic MS and provisional typed ME without reviving the failed four-axis instrument or collapsing multiple memories into one choice.

scientific_unit.grain: one runtime-visible state by one component by that component's frozen actual Rank-1 candidate

review_instrument.evidence_mode: pre-numbered exact span identifiers only; no free-form copied quotations required
review_instrument.abstain_rule: Use SEMANTIC_ABSTAIN only when the frozen visible state and candidate do not resolve the bounded suitability question; never use it as a confidence score or silently convert it to NOT_SUITABLE.

MP.name: Profile-based Personalization
MP.suitable_minimum: The profile candidate can silently change a concrete constraint, logistical detail, framing choice or materially relevant premise of the next response.
MP.forbidden_positive_shortcut: Profile presence, profession naming or topic overlap alone never establishes SUITABLE.

MS.name: Atomic cross-session memory
MS.suitable_minimum: The exact strictly-past seeker evidence adds a current-unseen continuity cue that can change understanding, one question, a response constraint or the current option while preserving uncertainty about whether it still holds.
MS.forbidden_positive_shortcut: Source-session ancestry, influenced_by lineage, semantic topic overlap or retrieval score alone never establishes SUITABLE.

ME.name: Typed past action-result option
ME.suitable_minimum: The exact past action-result can serve the current goal as tentative user-owned evidence or one easily declined transferable option without becoming a rule or guarantee.
ME.forbidden_positive_shortcut: Typed compiler validity or a complete action-result pair alone never establishes SUITABLE.
ME.independent_of_rs: Judge ME on its own prospective resource suitability; do not mark it NOT_SUITABLE merely because RS is also present. ME-RS interaction is measured later by the joint planner and same-stack outcomes.

sampling: within every connected group include at least two non-job profile-field cases when available
balance high and low scope score and margin without treating either as a label
diversify actual candidate identity and candidate age
include every one of the 21 low-information Rank-1 cases
include every one of the 32 exact-or-containment current-echo cases
within group fill across score, margin, age, length and candidate reuse
proxy strata select review coverage but never create a target label
include all 15 connected groups, including the one group with only one present case
include all 23 distinct action-result candidates at least once
then fill up to seven per group across score, margin, age and candidate reuse
remain provisional until bidirectional resolved labels exist across groups

packet_capacity.co_presence_requirement: For each of the 14 groups containing MP+MS+ME co-present states, include at least one shared state in all three component packets; keep three separate review cases and permit three SUITABLE decisions.
packet_capacity.sample_size_rationale: Twelve cases per MP/MS connected group yields 204 reviewed cases per primary memory head, so a typical outer-train partition retains roughly 160 cases for a frozen low-dimensional regularized model while group count, not state count, remains the uncertainty unit. ME uses the largest nearly balanced capped sample supported by its sparse 15-group surface.

reviewer_visible: role-marked runtime-visible dialogue through the current seeker turn
exact frozen candidate spans with owner/time kind but no identity alias
pre-numbered visible and candidate span identifiers
physically_private: diagnostic sampling stratum and proxy flags
candidate reuse count and selection order
forbidden_everywhere_in_review_payload: quality, risk, function or cost outcome

reviewer_qualification.failure_behavior: A reviewer failing one component may not label that component's public packet. Failure does not disable other qualified components. A fresh predeclared replacement reviewer may qualify once; controls, thresholds and codebook may not be changed after seeing qualification results.

pre_adjudication_and_label_freeze.primary_training_label_rule: Only exact SUITABLE/SUITABLE or NOT_SUITABLE/NOT_SUITABLE consensus creates a primary binary training label.
pre_adjudication_and_label_freeze.disagreement_or_any_abstain: UNRESOLVED; runtime defaults OFF and the row is excluded from primary binary training.
pre_adjudication_and_label_freeze.adjudication: Optional identified third-reviewer adjudication is reported separately and may support sensitivity analysis, but never rewrites pre-adjudication agreement and is not required to manufacture primary labels.
pre_adjudication_and_label_freeze.head_failure_behavior: A component that fails reproducibility or resolved-capacity gates is fixed OFF for Paper 1; no threshold, sample, reason-code or codebook edits on the same reviewed cases.
